_note: Exact model names and free-tier limits are confirmed at run time from each provider's live model list and limits page; 'verified' records when. Limits are applied at 80% (Limits.safety).

claude.provider: Claude subscription via Claude Code headless mode (claude -p)
claude._system_prompt_note: Measured 2026-10-27 on the same prompt: default system prompt 6,425 input tokens; --system-prompt '' 1,684; Gemini 536 / Groq 581. ~1,100 CLI-added tokens remain. A whitespace-only system prompt is rejected (400). See results/smoke/claude_system_prompt_comparison_2026-10-27.json.
claude.choice_reason: Alias 'sonnet' resolved to claude-sonnet-5 on CLI 2.1.283 (modelUsage of a live call, 2026-10-27); pinned to that full name. The CLI did not recognize claude-sonnet-5-5.

gemini.limits_source: Google AI Studio > Rate Limit page, Free tier, read 2026-10-26. Flash models (3.6/3.8 Flash): 5 RPM, 250K TPM, 20 RPD; Flash-Lite (3.5/3.1): 15 RPM, 250K TPM, 500 RPD.
gemini.choice_reason: Flash models' 20 RPD would need 10+ days for the pilot alone; 3.5 Flash Lite is the newest non-preview text model with 500 RPD.

groq.limits_source: x-ratelimit-* headers on a live call 2026-10-26: limit-requests=1000 (per day), limit-tokens=8000 (per minute). Groq docs table also lists 200K tokens/day (not reported in headers; a per-day 429 stops the run cleanly).
groq.choice_reason: Live Groq list (2026-10-26) has no Llama 3.3 70B; chat models are gpt-oss-120b/20b and qwen3.8-27b. Qwen is planned for self-hosting, so gpt-oss-120b gives a distinct (OpenAI open-weight) family.

mistral.provider: Mistral La Plateforme, free Experiment plan (data-training opt-in)
mistral.disabled_reason: 2026-10-26: Mistral console showed the organization on the Free plan with API keys inactive ('Upgrade to activate your API keys'); the plan list offered Free (chat only), Pro, Team and Pay-as-you-go, with no free Experiment API plan. Replaced by a self-hosted Mistral open-weight model (mistral_vllm).

qwen_groq.limits_source: x-ratelimit-* headers on a live call 2026-10-27: limit-requests=1000 (per day), limit-tokens=8000 (per minute). Groq docs table also lists 200K tokens/day.
qwen_groq.choice_reason: Only Qwen model in the live Groq list (2026-10-26); Groq limits are per model.

mistral_nvidia.limits_source: 40 RPM per third-party guides and an NVIDIA forum thread; not in official docs. Confirm from headers / first calls.
mistral_nvidia.choice_reason: Mistral's own API has no free plan (2026-10-26). Live NVIDIA model list (2026-10-27) has mistral-large-2-instruct, mixtral-8x22b-v0.1, mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3, mistral-nemo-12b-instruct; Large 2 is the most capable.
mistral_nvidia.disabled_reason: 2026-10-27: key accepted for the model list (85 models), but every chat call returned 404 'Function ... Not found for account' (mistral-large-2-instruct, mistral-large, mixtral-8x22b-v0.1, mistral-nemo-12b-instruct, mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3, and non-Mistral nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b, gemma-3-12b-it); some calls timed out. The account has no working inference access.

qwen_vllm.provider: Self-hosted with vLLM on an NVIDIA Brev GPU (Brev credits); see docs/BREV_SETUP.md
qwen_vllm.disabled_reason: 2026-10-27: Brev credit code lost and no credits confirmed in the Brev console, so no GPU to self-host on. Kept for reproducibility if credits become available.
